title: docs(skills): the plugin-lifecycle Plugin Interface example imports what it uses
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"huangyiirene"} -->
_Requested by **Irene** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x?thread=cmsg_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67xPXtjR5PCWfVipHWqjksUoZ)_

Part of #31112

Slice 10 of the card: item 4 follow-up, the example blocks in `skills/objectstack-platform/rules/*.md` (`plugin-lifecycle.md`, `service-registry.md`).

## 维护者速读

**需要你做的:** 本 PR 为 **Tier H**(`skills/**`,`check-governed-merges.mjs --test` 实测 GOVERNED),保持 draft;当前 head 还欠契约审查(contract review),由 skills 席位按 `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` 做记录审查,通过后席位再请你批准。
改了什么:`rules/plugin-lifecycle.md` 的 Plugin Interface 示例块原先 import 了它随后自己声明的 `Plugin`(TS2440),又用了未 import 的 `PluginType`(TS2304);现在 import `{ PluginContext, PluginType }`,与 slice 9(PR #32191)对 `plugin-development.md` 的同款修法一致。
两个 rules 文件的其余 23 个 ts 块都已对着 core 和 spec 的 `.d.ts` 逐块探测,没有发现其他与契约不符的行。
不加 `os:check` 标记:这些块都需要 `@objectstack/core` 或项目本地名字,或是片段,检查器只解析 `@objectstack/spec`。
token 行 +1(1787 → 1788 / 2408),没有改动任何上限,没有删减任何句子。

## What changes

- **`rules/plugin-lifecycle.md` § Plugin Interface (L38):** the block imported `Plugin` and then declared `export interface Plugin` (TS2440), and used `PluginType` without importing it (TS2304). The import is now `{ PluginContext, PluginType }`. The interface shape is unchanged. This is the twin that PR #32191's contract review (record 6768689767) escalated, and it now matches the overview in `references/plugin-development.md` L71.

PR #32191 (slice 9) has not merged yet. Its diff was read from its branch `claude/project-thread-5hjfcr` at `a8feafb4`, where `plugin-development.md` L71 reads `import type { PluginContext, PluginType } from '@objectstack/core';`. This PR uses the same line byte for byte.

### Diff

```diff
@@ skills/objectstack-platform/rules/plugin-lifecycle.md · § Plugin Interface
-import type { Plugin, PluginContext } from '@objectstack/core';
+import type { PluginContext, PluginType } from '@objectstack/core';
```

### Cut list, with surviving homes

None. No sentence is cut and no rule changes. The changed line is not pinned: `packages/*/src/**/*.test.ts` and `skills/objectstack-platform/evals/*.json` were grepped for it and for `plugin-lifecycle.md` (the only hits are core tests importing the type for their own code, and the ratchet and link checkers naming the file).

## Probe (all 24 ts blocks in the two rules files)

Each block was written alone to its own build dir and type-checked (`strict`, `skipLibCheck`) against the built `.d.ts` of `@objectstack/core` and `@objectstack/spec` (and `@objectstack/spec/*` subpaths), at `main` `0eca80a70` after a full `pnpm build`. Method fragments (`async init(ctx) { … }`) were wrapped in a probe-only class, `kernel.…` fragments got a probe-only `declare const kernel: ObjectKernel`, and project-local names (`createPool`, `connectDatabase`, `fs`, `AnalyticsService`, `Analytics`, `RequestLogger`, `UnitOfWork`, `InstrumentedCache`, `MemoryCache`, `RedisCache`, `data`, `process`) got stubs.

**The fixed block:**

| Block | `main` | this PR |
|:--|:--|:--|
| plugin-lifecycle.md L37 (Plugin Interface) | exit 2: `TS2440 Import declaration conflicts with local declaration of 'Plugin'` (1,15); `TS2304 Cannot find name 'PluginType'` (28,10) | exit 0 |

A parity probe also holds on this PR: the core `Plugin` is assignable to the overview's `Plugin`, and the overview declares no key the core contract lacks (exit 0).

**Every other block:**

| Result | Blocks |
|:--|:--|
| exit 0 | plugin-lifecycle.md L91, L156, L174, L205, L216, L236; service-registry.md L29, L45, L74, L84, L94, L107, L122, L137, L187, L200, L241, L251 |
| `TS18046 … is of type 'unknown'` only | plugin-lifecycle.md L128 (`pool`, `server`) and L184 (`pool`); service-registry.md L219 and L228 (`realtime`) |
| not TS (pseudo-signatures) | service-registry.md L9 |

None of these is a wrong line against a contract:

- **The `unknown` diagnostics** come from `ctx.getService('…')` written without a type argument, so `T` is `unknown`. L128 and L184 read `db-pool` and `http-server`, which are the example's own services with no contract to check against. For L219 and L228, the probe copy alone typed the call as `getService<IRealtimeService>('realtime')`, and both then compile (exit 0): the `publish({ type, payload, timestamp })` call slice 6 repaired matches `RealtimeEventPayload`. Slice 6 recorded the same reading. The same check on L137 (`getService<ICacheService>('cache')`) is exit 0.
- **L9** lists the four registry methods as pseudo-signatures. A probe that assigns each `PluginContext` member to the signature the block shows is exit 0. `replaceService(name, instance: any)` stays as written, per slice 6 (F2 accepted).
- Values read by eye against their accept sets: `'com.objectstack.engine.objectql'` is `ObjectQLPlugin.name` (`packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts` L487), and `'objectql'` is the key it registers (L858). `'metadata:reloaded'` is a declared lifecycle event (`plugin-lifecycle-events.ts` L135). `ServiceLifecycle.SINGLETON | TRANSIENT | SCOPED` are the enum's members, and `ObjectKernel.registerServiceFactory(name, factory, lifecycle, dependencies?)` takes the argument order the blocks use. No block sets a plugin `type`.

## Marks: none added

| File | marked before | after | Why it stays unmarked |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `rules/plugin-lifecycle.md` | 0/9 | 0/9 | Every block needs `@objectstack/core` (`Plugin`, `PluginContext`, `PluginType`) or is a method fragment. |
| `rules/service-registry.md` | 0/15 | 0/15 | Every block needs `@objectstack/core` (`PluginContext`, `ServiceLifecycle`, a kernel) or is a fragment or pseudo-signature list. |

Spec-only probe of the raw blocks (the resolution `check:skill-examples` uses): 0 of 24 self-contained. 17 are syntax-level fragments (`TS1434`/`TS1005`, L9 also `TS1109`); L37 is `TS2307` (cannot find `@objectstack/core`); the 3 `Plugin`-typed objects resolve `Plugin` to lib.dom's and fail `TS2353`, with `TS2304` on core or project names; the 3 `kernel.registerServiceFactory` blocks fail `TS2304` on `kernel`, `ServiceLifecycle` and a project-local name. Per slice 6's ruling, no per-file note is added to the files.

## Verification

- Token ratchet (`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` :: exit 0): `rules/plugin-lifecycle.md` 1787 → 1788 / 2408; `rules/service-registry.md` 1808 / 2331 (untouched). No ceiling raised or lowered.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:skill-examples` :: exit 0, 343 prose examples across 3 surfaces (unchanged; no mark added).
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives 44 commands at `93a2f07d`, after a full `pnpm build`. All 44 exit 0, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:dts-closure` included. `dispatch-gates --ran` exit 0: 44 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. Head `f033a041` is `93a2f07d` plus a merge of `origin/main` touching no `skills/`, `packages/spec/` or `packages/core/` path; the token ratchet, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-empty-changeset`, `check:skill-links` and the trailer check were re-run there, all exit 0. The record is in the project files as `card-31112/s10-gates-93a2f07d.txt`.
- `node scripts/check-commit-card-trailers.mjs --range origin/main..HEAD` :: exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --test <2 paths> --additions 11 --deletions 1`: GOVERNED (Tier H, `skills/**`).
- Contract review: `dispatch-gates --tier` mandates `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` for `skills/**` (clause ①). The maintainer's standing order of 2026-11-03 waives that build tier for card threads. The skills seat runs the contract review of record at that tier.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind. (no names added)
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (no code changed)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (`.changeset/31112-platform-rules-plugin-interface.md`, `'@objectstack/skills': patch`)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English. (the 维护者速读 section is the lane's Chinese summary for the maintainer)
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
